name: Timetable
description: A weekly class timetable with rooms, colours and a live now line — click any slot to add a class
author: Lattice

config.label: Days shown
config.help: Classes on hidden days are kept — switch to Mon – Sat or Mon – Sun to see them.

config.label: Day starts at
config.help: The first hour on the card. A class that starts earlier expands the range automatically.

config.label: Day ends at
config.help: The last hour on the card. A class that ends later expands the range automatically.

config.label: Term starts
config.help: The Monday of week 1, used for odd / even weeks. Leave empty to show every class every week.

sections.title: Adding a class
items: Click an empty slot in the grid, or the + in the top bar. The editor opens with that day and time already filled in.
Give it a name, a room, a start and an end. Times look like 09:30; 9:30 also works.
Save with the button or Enter. Escape closes the editor without saving.

sections.title: Reading the week
items: Columns are weekdays, rows are hours. The header shows this week's dates, and today is marked in the accent colour.
A thin line across today's column is the current time; a class under it is outlined.
Colours are yours to choose in the editor — six tints that work on both light and dark boards.

sections.title: Changing or removing
items: Click a class block to edit it. Delete removes it immediately; there is no undo.
Two classes at the same time sit side by side instead of covering each other.
Short classes hide the room line so the name stays readable.

sections.title: Days and hours
items: Days shown, Day starts at and Day ends at are in the inspector, per copy.
A class outside the chosen hours expands the range for the whole week — nothing is silently cut off.
Classes on hidden days stay in storage; they are not deleted.

sections.title: Odd and even weeks
items: Set Term starts to the Monday of week 1, then pick Every week, Odd weeks or Even weeks in the editor.
The card shows the current week; classes for the other parity stay hidden until that week comes around.
With Term starts empty, every class is shown every week — parity is ignored rather than guessed.

sections.title: If it cannot save
items: The week label switches to Not saved when a write fails — usually a missing storage permission.
The timetable keeps working in memory until it can write again; grant storage in the inspector and edit once more.
Nothing is uploaded anywhere. There is no account and no network permission.

changes: First release: weekly grid with click-to-add classes, rooms, six colours and a live now line.
Click a class to edit or delete it; overlapping classes share the column.
Odd / even week support through Term starts, plus per-copy day range and visible days.
